class.name: MIDIResource
class.brief_description: Stores a parsed MIDI file, including its header and tracks.
class.description:
MIDIResource represents a Standard MIDI File loaded into memory. It stores the parsed MIDI header in a [MIDIHeader] resource and the parsed track data in an array of [MIDITrack] resources.
Use [method load_file] to load and parse a MIDI file from a filesystem path. The method reads the file, parses its header, and then parses the number of tracks declared by that header. Unknown chunks encountered before tracks are skipped.
If the file cannot be opened or a required header or track chunk cannot be parsed, loading fails and an error is returned. Loading a new file clears the previously stored tracks before parsing begins.
The [member header] and [member tracks] properties expose the parsed MIDI data for inspection and playback.
Saving is not currently implemented. [method save_file] returns [constant OK] without writing data to disk.

method.name: load_file
method.description:
Loads and parses a Standard MIDI File from the specified filesystem path.
Reads the file contents, parses the MIDI header, and loads the tracks declared in the header. Unknown chunks encountered while searching for track chunks are skipped.
Returns [constant OK] if loading succeeds. Returns [constant FAILED] if the file cannot be opened, the header cannot be parsed, the file runs out of data while skipping unknown chunks, or a track cannot be parsed.
Loading a new file clears the existing tracks before parsing begins. If parsing fails, the resource may contain partially updated data.

method.name: save_file
method.description:
Placeholder for saving a resource to a MIDI file.
This method is not implemented and currently returns [constant OK] without writing anything to disk. The [param path] and [param resource] arguments are ignored.

members.member: The parsed MIDI header, containing the file format, track count, and timing division.
The parsed MIDI tracks, stored as an array of [MIDITrack] resources. The number of tracks loaded from a file is determined by [member header].
